claims.text: The goal is that a reader talks to the newsroom with a capable model, free, on their own key, which the newsroom never holds.
claims.quote: A reader talks to the newsroom with a capable model, free, on their own key, which we never hold.

claims.text: The search page has two engines today: Chrome's built-in model, on the reader's machine with no key, and the reader's own OpenRouter key, which stays in the browser and goes only to OpenRouter.
claims.quote: Chrome's built-in model runs on the reader's own machine with no key and sends nothing anywhere

claims.text: OpenRouter's free models allow 50 requests a day until the reader has bought at least $10 of credit, and someone trying it should not need a card.
claims.quote: OpenRouter's free models allow 50 requests a day until you have bought at least $10 of credit.

value.unit: free requests a day before buying credit

claims.text: Two tests decide whether a provider works: free without a card, and callable from a web page directly so the key goes from the reader's browser to the provider and nowhere else.
claims.quote: Two tests decide it. Free without a card, and callable from a web page directly.

claims.text: The browser test sent a CORS preflight to every provider's chat endpoint from the newsroom's own address and recorded the answer; a provider that does not answer cannot be called from a page.
claims.quote: We sent that preflight to every provider's chat endpoint, from the newsroom's own address

claims.text: GitHub Models, the easiest free option for anyone with a GitHub account, was retired on 30 July 2026.
claims.quote: GitHub Models was retired on 30 July 2026.

claims.text: Hugging Face free accounts no longer get monthly credits for Inference Providers; its pricing page lists None for free users.
claims.quote: Hugging Face free accounts no longer get monthly credits

claims.text: Cerebras now needs a verified payment method; new accounts get $5 of credit that expires 30 days after it is granted.
claims.quote: New accounts get $5 of credit, which expires 30 days after it is granted

value.unit: dollars of credit, expiring in 30 days

claims.text: From 28 May 2026 new AI Studio keys are auth keys and the Gemini API rejects requests from unrestricted standard keys.
claims.quote: From 28 May 2026, new AI Studio keys are "auth keys"

claims.text: Groq is free with no card; its published table gives gpt-oss-120b 30 requests a minute, 1,000 a day and 200,000 tokens a day, requests are not retained by default, and the browser test allows any page.
claims.quote: 30 requests a minute, 1,000 a day and 200,000 tokens a day

value.unit: requests a day for gpt-oss-120b on Groq

claims.text: Gemini through AI Studio is free with a Google account from 18 with no card, its limits are shown only inside AI Studio, and the browser test allows the newsroom's address.
claims.quote: Limits are no longer published and are shown only inside AI Studio.

claims.text: On Gemini's free tier Google uses what is sent to improve its products, human reviewers may read it, and the terms carve out the UK, the EEA and Switzerland, where paid terms apply.
claims.quote: human reviewers may read, annotate, and process your API input and output

claims.text: Mistral's free mode needs no credit card, limits are in the console, and requests may be used to improve the models unless anonymous improvement data is switched off.
claims.quote: Requests may be used to improve the models unless you switch off "Anonymous improvement data" in the admin privacy settings.

claims.text: OpenRouter's free list on 18 October had 19 entries, including Nemotron 3 Ultra and Gemma 4, and a free router that picks a free model for you.
claims.quote: The free list on 18 October had 19 entries

claims.text: OpenRouter has what the others lack, a sign-in for apps through OAuth with PKCE: the reader approves, the page receives a key of their own, and the reader never copies a key and can revoke it.
claims.quote: The reader never copies or pastes a key, and can revoke it at OpenRouter.

claims.text: Cohere's trial key is free on registration with 1,000 calls a month and chat at 20 a minute, on its own API shape, and the browser test allows any page.
claims.quote: 1,000 calls a month, chat at 20 a minute, with the Command A family

value.unit: calls a month on Cohere's trial key

claims.text: Pollinations answered a chat request with no key at all, but its docs expect keys, so keyless use is treated as tolerated, not promised; it also has a sign-in flow.
claims.quote: we would treat keyless use as tolerated, not promised

claims.text: Cloudflare Workers AI has the most generous free allowance found, 10,000 neurons a day, roughly 100,000 to 300,000 tokens of gpt-oss-120b, but its API refused the browser preflight, so a Worker is needed.
claims.quote: 10,000 "neurons" a day on a free Cloudflare account

value.unit: neurons a day on a free Cloudflare account

claims.text: Cloudflare does not use Customer Content processed by Workers AI to train AI models.
claims.quote: Cloudflare does not use Customer Content processed by Workers AI to train AI models.

claims.text: Alibaba Model Studio gives about a million free tokens per model for 90 days and never uses data for training, but the Free Quota Only switch is off by default, so a reader must turn it on or be billed.
claims.quote: the "Free Quota Only" switch is now off by default

claims.text: NVIDIA's catalogue is strong and free but fails the browser test, needs a phone check by many reports, and its terms say trial use only; good for a developer's script, not for readers from a page.
claims.quote: It is a good place for a developer to try models from a script. It is not something to offer readers from a page.

claims.text: NVIDIA's live catalogue holds 81 models, including Kimi K2.6, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and the Nemotron 3 family.
claims.quote: the Nemotron 3 family, 81 models in all

claims.text: The design is bring your own key: kept in the browser or the reader's vault, sent from the browser to the provider with the question and the passages, and nowhere else, and the newsroom never holds it.
claims.quote: The design is bring your own key, and the newsroom never holds it.

claims.text: A key in a page can be read by any script on that page, so the page that holds it must load nothing it does not control; the safest keys are issued by a sign-in, scoped and revocable.
claims.quote: A key in a page can be read by any script on that page, so the page that holds it must load nothing it does not control.

claims.text: An agent should not create the account for a reader, for three reasons: sign-ups ask for phones or captchas on purpose, OpenRouter's terms forbid multiple accounts to bypass limits, and providers are watching for it.
claims.quote: I think it should not, for three reasons.

claims.text: NVIDIA's forum moderators already report ten to twenty automated rate-limit requests a day written by AI agents.
claims.quote: NVIDIA's forum moderators already report ten to twenty automated rate-limit requests a day written by AI agents

value.unit: automated requests a day, upper figure

claims.text: A free, keyless, dependable frontier model for everyone is not possible as far as the research found; Pollinations comes closest and says it is not guaranteed.
claims.quote: A free, keyless, dependable frontier model for everyone.

claims.text: In 2026 four free offers the newsroom would have recommended at the start of the year disappeared or gained a card: GitHub Models, Hugging Face's credits, Cerebras and SambaNova.
claims.quote: four free offers we would have recommended at the start of the year disappeared or gained a card

value.unit: free offers lost or gated in 2026

claims.text: The newsroom will add Groq, Gemini and Mistral beside OpenRouter on the search page, each with a short guide to signing up, the privacy setting, the model and what the provider does with your words.
claims.quote: Add Groq, Gemini and Mistral beside OpenRouter on the search page

claims.text: Then use OpenRouter's sign-in instead of a pasted key, let the key live in the reader's vault, publish a Worker for Cloudflare, and recheck the map every quarter.
claims.quote: Recheck this map every quarter, because it will change.

claims.text: Everything is a snapshot as of 18 October 2026, and free tiers change often.
claims.quote: Everything here is as of 18 October 2026, and free tiers change often.

claims.text: Limits move: several providers show them only inside their consoles, and the article reports what is published.
claims.quote: Several providers show limits only inside their consoles; we report what is published.

claims.text: Third-party facts are marked: phone checks at NVIDIA, SambaNova's date and Z.ai's concurrency are reported, not confirmed.
claims.quote: Phone checks at NVIDIA, SambaNova's date and Z.ai's concurrency are reported, not confirmed.

claims.text: The browser test is one test, a preflight from the newsroom's address, and a provider can change its headers at any time.
claims.quote: A preflight from our address; a provider can change its headers at any time.

claims.text: The article is not legal advice; the UK, EEA and Swiss carve-outs in Gemini's terms are summarised, not interpreted.
claims.quote: The UK, EEA and Swiss carve-outs in Gemini's terms are summarised, not interpreted.
